title: The 2-D shapes game
creator_credit: Stephen Bosustow Productions and Stephen Bosustow
brief_description: A magic drawing board introduces children to the 5 basic 2-dimensional shapes (square, circle, triangle, rectangle and ellipse). The film establishes the characteristics of regular plane shapes and helps children to recognize and name them. Suitable for primary grades.
